content: Browser Canvas 2D CanvasRenderingContext2D.direction property (ltr/rtl/inherit) is baseline-supported across Chrome and Safari, including mobile, since May 2022. Setting ctx.direction='rtl' before fillText() makes the browser apply proper bidi reordering and correct glyph shaping for Hebrew text drawn on canvas. Canvas fillText does not auto-wrap text in any language -- word-wrap must be implemented manually, but bidi correctness is handled by the browser once direction is set.
